finding: adjacent-slice fill sharing does not depend on the traffic a launch replays between two touches of the same line
selection_rule: fills per delivered byte for two AICs on adjacent column slices, swept over how many tiles each walks before returning to a line
description: Pairs with fia_kv_line_fill_span. Two AICs read adjacent `columns`-wide slices of the same strided rows; every byte is read once. Growing the tile count puts the rest of the walk between two touches of one line, which is what a SplitFuse prefill launch does when it replays K/V per Q tile. The ratio is unchanged across a 256-fold range of intervening traffic, so the sharing is concurrent rather than residency-limited, and a capacity gate keyed on replayed traffic is not supported.
